## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 30. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke begins by looking backward: in retrospect, he does not think we give enough credit to Jim Harbaugh and David Shaw for what they did at Stanford, and says if somebody can replicate that in today's NIL era it will be one of the best coaching jobs we have ever seen. He records the resources — a $50 million donation in October 2025 from former player Bradford Freeman, and a revenue-sharing model instituted in spring 2025 — then the constraint: even with the weight that a Stanford degree carries, Andrew Luck and now Pritchard, who played for the Cardinal from 2006-09 and coached for them from 2011-22, know the academic requirements in Palo Alto severely limit the player pool. He notes Pritchard has spent the last three seasons with the Commanders coaching up QBs, including Jayden Daniels. His verdict is one word: 'unimaginative' is the best way to describe the hire after Frank Reich responded to Luck's plea to serve as a stopgap last season.
